maria: Quick sync — ran end-to-end perf on the MoE routing + TP+PP config. Repro: 8 TP shards, 2 PP stages, 4 experts per shard, batch=64, max_len=1024. Observed consistent all-to-all wall time spikes at token boundaries and huge KV cache churn when guests hit cold experts.

kevin: Can you paste the perf timeline / flamegraph? Is this during forward or also backward?

maria: Forward-heavy. Flame attached (summary): all_to_all_xfer dominates 35-45% of step time, then NCCL allreduce ~12%. KV cache eviction events align with A2A peaks.

sam: initial thought: routing produces imbalanced packet sizes -> small messages cause high PCIe/NIC overhead. Are we seeing lots of small A2A ops instead of batched exchanges?

maria: Yep. Trace shows hundreds of small sends per step because we do token-level routing without aggregation. Also kernel dispatch for softmax+topk per-token is firing separately -> kernel-launch overhead stacks.

julia: Can you share the routing snippet? Maybe we can coalesce tokens into 64-token groups before doing A2A.

maria: Snippet:```python
# routing config
route_batch = True
coalesce_window = 1  # current
# suggested change -> coalesce_window=64
```

kevin: Try coalesce_window=32/64 and enable async allreduce + overlap. Also switch fused softmax+topk kernel (fusible op) instead of two kernels. That reduces launches and improves register reuse.

sam: Another angle: KV cache behavior. If we store per-expert KV on host pinned memory for cold experts, transfers spike. Can we keep KV resident on-device per expert and only stream TTL-evicted rows?

maria: We tried keeping per-expert KV on-device but hit memory budget on PP stage 0. Tradeoff: less A2A but more memory pressure. Maybe combined strategy: hot-expert in-device, cold paged to fast host pinned mem + async DMA.

julia: Also profiling shows NCCL clique fallback for some steps -> fallback causes serialized collectives. Ensure NCCL topo consistent and increase NCCL_P2P_LEVEL or set NCCL_ALGO=RING for our fabric?

kevin: Proposed experiments (assign):
- coalesce routing tokens (maria)
- switch to fused softmax+topk kernel (sam)
- per-expert hot/cold KV policy + async DMA (julia)
- NCCL env tuning + microbench (kevin)

maria: I'll run coalesce 32/64 today and post microbench. If coalescing cuts A2A ops by >3x we might hit target latency.

infra-bot: prod-test cluster provisioned: rtx-a100-8x per node, fabric=nvlink+ib, job id=prod-pp-test-4821 (reaction :rocket:)

kevin: One more note: batching heuristics should adapt to sequence length distribution. For many short sequences, coalescing across requests reduces per-token routing overhead. Add metric for "routing-msg-count" to console.

maria: Good call. I'll add a small counter to tracing and push results by EOD. Thanks. :thumbsup:
